entities.name: FtsH protease
observations: Sequence is 636 aa long and contains two N-terminal transmembrane helices followed by a large cytosolic domain.
Pfam matches: FtsH_ext at residues 9-94, AAA at 192-324, AAA_lid_3 at 347-390, and Peptidase_M41 at 406-594.
Homologs include reviewed FtsH proteins with 63.5-67.0% identity and 93.9-98.1% query coverage.
FtsH is an ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease involved in membrane and cytosolic protein quality control.
Reference FtsH proteins are homohexameric inner-membrane proteases with one Zn2+ per subunit.
GO annotations in homologs include ATP binding, ATP hydrolysis, ATP-dependent peptidase activity, metalloendopeptidase activity, zinc ion binding, proteolysis, and protein catabolic process.
